title: ZipServ: Fast and Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Hardware-Aware Lossless Compression
authors: Ruibo Fan; Xiangrui Yu; Xinglin Pan; Zeyu Li; Weile Luo; Qiang Wang; Wei Wang; Xiaowen Chu
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS 2026)
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen; Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
research_focus: LLM serving, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Hardware co-design, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Lossless compression can reduce model memory footprint and bandwidth demand, but conventional entropy codecs are poorly matched to GPU inference: variable-length bitstreams break SIMT parallelism and decoupled decompression creates extra memory traffic.
problem_statement.zh: Lossless compression 可降低模型記憶體占用與 bandwidth demand，但傳統 entropy codec 不適合 GPU inference：variable-length bitstream 破壞 SIMT parallelism，而分離式 decompression 會產生額外 memory traffic。

key_innovation.en: ZipServ co-designs a fixed-length Tensor-Core-Aware Triple Bitmap Encoding format with ZipGEMM, a fused decompression-GEMM kernel. The kernel loads compressed weights, reconstructs them directly into Tensor Core registers, and computes without intermediate buffers; the system uses stage-aware integration to avoid slowing compute-bound prefill.
key_innovation.zh: ZipServ 將固定長度的 Tensor-Core-Aware Triple Bitmap Encoding 與 fused decompression-GEMM kernel ZipGEMM 協同設計。Kernel 載入壓縮權重後直接在 Tensor Core register 中重建並計算，不產生中間 buffer；系統端用 stage-aware integration 避免拖慢 compute-bound prefill。

baselines_compared: cuBLAS Tensor Core GEMM, DietGPU, nvCOMP, DFloat11, vLLM, Transformers

key_improvements.en: Reduces model size by up to 30%, achieves up to 2.21x kernel-level speedup over cuBLAS, and improves end-to-end inference by 1.22x on average over vLLM. Reported memory savings reduce LLaMA3.1-8B weights from 14.96 GB to 10.83 GB and LLaMA3.1-70B from 131.56 GB to 93.52 GB.
key_improvements.zh: 模型大小最高降低 30%，kernel-level 相較 cuBLAS 最高加速 2.21x，端到端相較 vLLM 平均加速 1.22x。記憶體節省方面，LLaMA3.1-8B 權重由 14.96 GB 降至 10.83 GB，LLaMA3.1-70B 由 131.56 GB 降至 93.52 GB。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX4090, NVIDIA L40S, NVIDIA RTX5090, NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA H800
gpu_count: 1x RTX4090; 2x L40S; 4x L40S; RTX5090 single-GPU kernel experiments
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (compression/kernel system; reports memory savings, kernel speedup, and end-to-end latency/throughput rather than predictor error)
models_validated: LLaMA3.1-8B, LLaMA3.1-70B, LLaMA3.1-405B, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen2.5-32B, Qwen2.5-72B, Gemma3-12B, Gemma3-27B, Mistral-24B, Mistral-123B
validation_workloads: Synthetic GEMM/model-layer workloads; end-to-end LLaMA and Mistral decoding workloads

scope_assumptions.en: ZipServ assumes weight values can be compressed losslessly into the proposed fixed-length bitmap format with sufficient density gains. It changes GEMM memory-traffic and compute-intensity assumptions, but does not address KV-cache compression, request scheduling, or framework overhead.
scope_assumptions.zh: ZipServ 假設權重值能以所提出的固定長度 bitmap format 進行 lossless compression 並取得足夠 density gains。它改變 GEMM memory traffic 與 compute intensity 假設，但不處理 KV-cache compression、request scheduling 或 framework overhead。
